text: When a job fails, three functions decide its future. Let's follow one failure through them.
The worker catches the error in Runner.Worker.perform, and hands the job to Retry.Scheduler.plan.
plan reads the attempt count from the job row and asks Retry.Backoff.compute for the delay.
compute returns two to the attempt, plus a random jitter capped at thirty seconds.
plan writes scheduled_at as now plus that delay, and the job goes back to available.
When attempt reaches max_attempts, plan skips the delay and calls Retry.Scheduler.give_up.
give_up sets the state to discarded and records the last error. Nothing picks it up after that.
So: perform catches, plan decides, compute times, and give_up ends it.
